description: Draw 1 to 4 KPI cards as one image: each a big number with its label, optional change since the last period (green when good, red when bad) and an optional sparkline of recent values. For report emails, Slack updates and dashboards in documents. To combine KPI cards with charts in one image use generate_dashboard. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

items.description: One to four cards, left to right.

caption.description: Shown after the change, e.g. 'vs last week'.

delta.description: Change since the last period: a percentage, or an amount with deltaMode 'absolute'.

deltaMode.description: How to read delta: percent (default) or absolute.

goodWhen.description: 'down' for numbers where lower is better (churn, costs, errors).

trend.description: Recent values, oldest first, for the sparkline.

title.description: Heading above the cards, e.g. 'This week'.

name: generate_kpi_card
title: KPI cards
